data.content_ref: inline:The target answers the wrong question. The problem requires identifying what evidence *within a single evaluation* would distinguish a genuine reliability gain from mere checklist compliance that happens to track the right answer. SRC_001 instead argues a substantive claim about black-swan anomalies and offers two counterconditions describing when its claim would NOT hold. Neither the mechanism nor the counterconditions supplies the requested discriminating-evidence criterion. The counterconditions are scope-of-claim exclusions ('outcomes entirely contained within checklist parameters'; 'panel encouraged to report out-of-bounds observations'), not intra-evaluation evidentiary tests that separate true reliability from coincidentally-correct compliance. The target thus never engages the distinguishing-evidence requirement that defines the problem.
